title: Iabin
summary: Raleigh names Iabin in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Iabin of Hazor, slaughtered by Iosua. Not Iabin the second, who rebuilt Hazor after Ehud. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VI, §. II, sig. 208b
